functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Approximate federated Spearman rank correlation using global histogram midranks.

arguments.name: n_bins
arguments.description: Number of bins used to approximate global ranks.

arguments.name: approx_pvalues
arguments.description: Whether to compute approximate asymptotic p-values.

functions.name: federated_function
functions.description: Compute local summaries, histograms, or pairwise approximate-rank sufficient statistics.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: One of summary, histogram, or pair_stats.

arguments.name: bin_edges
arguments.description: Global bin edges for histogram mode.

arguments.name: rank_maps
arguments.description: Global approximate rank maps for pair_stats mode.
